veranderings.rede: "'n Beker water werk ook" is a calque of English "a cup of water works too"; "kan jy ... gebruik" is natural Afrikaans, keeps the permissive meaning, and is the same length.

vlae.teks: Moenie jou hande in die beker of die emmer steek nie
vlae.rede: 'Die emmer' is definite, but no bucket is mentioned before it: the sentences before it name only a cup of water. A language change cannot fix this without guessing the content (for example, whether the water is poured from or into a bucket), so it goes to the writer if it needs fixing. The hygiene instruction itself is clear and is not weakened.
